---
title: "Add another dog for an owner"
subtitle: "SOP GRM-04 · Groomer manual"
---

## Purpose

Add a second (or third) dog to an owner who is already on file, so the
owner's contact details are entered only once.

## Applies to

Every groomer, when an existing client brings a dog the shop has not seen
before.

## Before you begin

- You are signed in to your profile.
- One of the owner's dogs is already on file.

## Procedure

1. Find one of the owner's dogs on the Check-in screen and click it. See
   [GRM-02 Check in a dog](checking-in-a-dog.qmd), steps 2 to 4. The dog's
   card opens.
2. Click **▸ More details: vaccinations, last visit, contact** near the
   bottom of the dog's card. The details open.
3. In the **Last visit** box, click **+ Add another dog for** the owner's
   first name. The **Another dog for** form opens, with the owner's name. The
   owner's details are already filled in and are not shown.
4. Fill in the **Dog** box. See [GRM-03 Add a new client](new-client.qmd),
   steps 5 to 9.
5. Click **Save and add paperwork**. The **Paperwork for** form opens.
6. Add the dog's paperwork, or click **No paperwork today**. See [GRM-03 Add
   a new client](new-client.qmd), steps 11 and 12.

## Result

The new dog appears in the list on the Check-in screen under the same owner.
The other dog's card shows **Also brings** with the new dog's name.
